{

    {
      "question": "列出所有注册但从未下单的用户，返回user_id、user_name、register_date，按register_date升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "查询users表中不存在于orders表user_id中的用户记录，输出指定三列，稳定排序，无额外过滤。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.registered_no_order:user_id_user_name_register_date:order_by_register_date_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.register_date FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.user_id) ORDER BY u.register_date ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "找出所有有订单但从未购买过‘家用电器’类商品的用户，返回user_id、user_name、city，按user_id升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "customer",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "用户在orders中存在，但其所有order_items关联的product_id均不属于category='家用电器'的产品；输出指定三列，稳定排序。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.with_orders_no_home_appliance:user_id_user_name_city:order_by_user_id_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.city FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.user_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT u2.user_id FROM users u2 INNER JOIN orders o2 ON u2.user_id = o2.user_id INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o2.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = '家用电器' ) ORDER BY u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有上架但从未被任何有效订单购买过的商品，返回product_id、product_name、category、brand，按launch_date降序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "products表中is_active=1且无对应order_items记录（即未出现在任何有效订单明细中）的商品；输出指定四列，按上架时间倒序。",

      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.brand FROM products p WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id) ORDER BY p.launch_date DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "找出所有完成或已发货但未产生任何退款的订单，返回order_id、order_no、order_date、paid_amount，按order_date升序、order_id升序排列，最多100行。",
      "category": "filtering",

      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "orders中order_status IN ('completed','shipped')且该order_id在refunds中无refund_status='approved'记录；输出指定四列，双字段稳定排序。",

      "ordered": true
    },
    {

      "difficulty": "medium",

      "intended_meaning": "users.is_vip=1且其所有订单（orders.user_id匹配）的payment_method均不包含'wechat'；输出指定四列，双字段稳定排序。",

      "ordered": true

    {
      "question": "找出所有在2026年9月12日前注册但从未下单、也从未被退款关联过的用户，返回user_id、user_name、register_date，按register_date降序排列，最多100行。",

      "ordered": true

      "intended_meaning": "products.category='食品生鲜'且无任何refund记录（refunds.product_id匹配且refund_status='approved'）；输出指定四列，价格升序。",

      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "找出所有使用支付宝支付但订单中未包含‘手机数码’类商品的用户，返回user_id、user_name、province，按province升序、user_id升序排列，最多100行。",

      "ordered": true
